summary: Review found that the v2 assurance delivery gate can still certify incomplete or insufficiently evidenced run metadata, and the published v2 manifest example cannot satisfy the verifier that the change requires agents to run.

findings.title: Accepted mutation exceptions need only placeholder evidence
findings.trigger: A run records `checks.pit` as `pass`, uses an allowed `TIMED_OUT` disposition, sets `approvedBy` to any non-empty string, and points `evidence` at a placeholder file such as `logs/pit.log`; with `Final gate: PASS WITH ACCEPTED EXCEPTIONS`, verification succeeds.
findings.consequence: A required assurance run can pass delivery even when the timed-out mutation lacks the adapter-required focused rerun, unmutated-test result, complete XML/log evidence, and source-level liveness explanation.
findings.evidence: `verify_run.py:122-141` validates only the self-reported allowlist and the existence of evidence files, while `verify_run.py:211-213` accepts any non-empty exception list for the passing exception gate. The active adapter requires five specific evidence categories at `.agents/skills/contract-first-assurance/adapters/vformation.yaml:31-40`.
findings.suggestedFix: Snapshot the full resolved accepted-disposition policy, including required evidence categories, in the manifest. Require each category to have a referenced, hashed evidence record before accepting `PASS WITH ACCEPTED EXCEPTIONS`.

findings.title: Passing runs can omit or forge the frozen input package
findings.trigger: A final v2 manifest uses `inputs: {}` or maps `inputs` to the post-run root artifact `contract.md` instead of files under `inputs/`, while all required check values and the report final gate are `pass`.
findings.consequence: The verifier returns success although the contract sources, sanitized API, and adapter snapshot were never frozen before phase one. A result generated after verification can masquerade as an input, so the passing run is not reproducible.
findings.evidence: `verify_hashes` only iterates whatever mapping it receives at `verify_run.py:218-235`; `safe_path` permits root-relative `contract.md` at `verify_run.py:33-40`. The required setup copies contract sources, API views, and adapter configuration into `${RUN_DIR}/inputs/` before phase one at `.agents/skills/contract-first-assurance/SKILL.md:36-43`.
findings.suggestedFix: For a passing final manifest, require a non-empty input map whose entries are under `inputs/`, and record required frozen input roles such as contract source, API view, and resolved adapter so the verifier can reject missing or output-backed inputs.

findings.title: Mutable or invalid workspace references pass reproducibility verification
findings.trigger: A manifest sets `workspace.base` to `origin/dev/v0.5.0` and `workspace.head` to `HEAD`, supplies otherwise passing gates and artifacts, and omits `finalHead`.
findings.consequence: The delivery verifier accepts a run whose source identity moves as refs advance, so another worktree cannot reproduce the reviewed code revision.
findings.evidence: The verifier checks only that `base`, `head`, and `dirty` keys exist at `verify_run.py:79-81`, then performs only an optional equality check for `finalHead` at `verify_run.py:83-85`. The v2 run contract requires resolved commit IDs rather than symbolic refs at `.agents/skills/contract-first-assurance/references/reproducible-runs.md:65`.
findings.suggestedFix: Require `workspace.base` and `workspace.head` to be full immutable Git object IDs, validate `finalHead` when the schema includes it, and update the verifier fixtures to use valid object-ID-shaped values.

findings.title: Whitespace gate names satisfy the non-empty required-gate check
findings.trigger: A malformed resolved adapter contains `requiredGates: [" "]`, the top-level list matches it, and `checks` contains `{ " ": "pass" }` with a `PASS` report.
findings.consequence: The verifier reports a passing run even though no meaningful route gate was resolved or evidenced, bypassing the new required-gate assurance condition.
findings.evidence: The adapter gate validation at `verify_run.py:95-99` and top-level validation at `verify_run.py:150-155` require only Python strings, not non-blank valid gate identifiers. The host contract defines the actual current gate names at `.agents/skills/contract-first-assurance/references/host-adapter.md:72-74`.
findings.suggestedFix: Reject blank and whitespace-only gate names, reject duplicates, and validate the resolved list against a frozen adapter route entry or adapter-provided valid-gate set.

findings.title: The documented v2 completed manifest fails its required verifier
findings.trigger: An agent follows the shown v2 manifest shape and hashes only `report.md` in `artifacts`, then runs `verify_run.py` as directed after finalization.
findings.consequence: The verifier rejects the documented normal path because hashes for `contract.md`, `contract-gaps.md`, `candidate-status.csv`, and `verification-summary.md` are missing, blocking an otherwise compliant run.
findings.evidence: The v2 example shows only `"artifacts": {"report.md": "<sha256>"}` at `reproducible-runs.md:49`, while `verify_run.py:238-240` requires every file in `REQUIRED_FILES` to be present in the artifact hash map.
findings.suggestedFix: Expand the completed-manifest example to include hashes for every required artifact, or explicitly mark it as a partial illustration and provide a separately verifier-valid full example.
